title: Existence of the finite quotient calculus
statement: For every coefficient tensor record T, the actual finite quotient extension and restriction data assemble into a finite quotient calculus on T.

source.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 0941; finite quotient change-of-rings construction

proof.text: For each n ≤ m use the actual quotient map B_m → B_n. The ordinary change-of-rings adjunction and its sheafified unit give the ordinary-unit field. The recorded derived change-of-rings witness gives the derived adjunction, universal counit and K-flat preservation. The prescribed scalar tensor comparison, specialized to this quotient pair, supplies the pure-tensor normalization; these fields assemble independently for all quotient indices.
